plainText:
Valiant Venomoth! (Japanese: VSモルフォン VS ) is the 73rd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 33rd chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 and Sabrina are searching for the Elite Four in the Cave when they see something very, very unusual to be in a cave, and to be floating over a spiky rock: a . And suddenly, Green and Sabrina are ice handcuffed together. Lorelei appears and explains that when she marks an '×' on an ice doll with her lipstick, an ice handcuff appears there, and that if a part of the ice doll shatters, then that place on the victim shatters too. Lorelei's Cloyster then flashes an at Green and Sabrina, who jump in opposite directions and only miss the Ice Beam by falling. Green then sends out her and tells it to use , while Sabrina has her use . Lorelei's Cloyster blows the Sleep Powder away with a attack, and the Sleep Powder lands on Nido, who falls asleep instantly. Lorelei sends out , and it uses , which misses Sabrina and Green.

Sabrina wonders if Lorelei is aiming all her attacks at Green. Lorelei shows them , and tells them that her brought her "this little present," and if they want back, they will have to come to Lorelei. Green walks over, and Lorelei gives back Horsea but has her Jynx them, knocking Green unconscious. Sabrina was right: Lorelei was trying to hit Green so that Sabrina would have to pull Green along by herself. Sabrina's Venomoth tries to steal the voodoo dolls, but Cloyster . Venomoth tries again and again, but Cloyster closes its shell twice more. Lorelei notices something and pulls the voodoo dolls out from inside 's shell. Cloyster then faints from Venomoth's repeating attack.

==Major events==
's is revealed to have evolved into a .
Sabrina and Green battle Lorelei after being frozen on the arms by her dolls.
Sabrina defeats one of Lorelei's Pokémon.
and Lt. Surge end up at a lake on Cerise Island.
